reviews.review_text:
Susantha Travel
Colombo, Sri Lanka2 contributions
1
Disappointing experience.
Apr 2024 • Couples
La Salle à Manger was a restaurant I had high hopes for, given its charming ambiance and appealing menu. However, my recent visit left a lot to be desired, primarily due to the disappointing service we received.

Our evening started off well with prompt seating and an initially attentive and welcoming hostess that kindly offered us a tour of the different spaces. Yet, as the meal progressed, the service deteriorated markedly. First, the waiter didn't get the full order. Then, the most striking issue occurred when I attempted to order dessert. As I was speaking, our waiter abruptly walked away mid-sentence, attending to another table without any excuse or acknowledgement. This was not only rude but also diminished our dining experience significantly. The guests with me as well as customers at neighbouring tables were shocked by such a behaviour. 

Though the rest of the staff repeatedly apologized for our waiter's behavior, acknowledging the disruption wasn't enough. No tangible resolutions like a discount or complimentary service were offered to make up for the inconvenience. This lack of consideration for customer satisfaction was surprising and not something I expect from a restaurant that prides itself on a quality dining experience.

Furthermore, the non-smoking area, where we were seated, was exceptionally noisy, making it difficult to enjoy our conversation without raising our voices.

Overall, La Salle à Manger did not live up to the expectations set by its reputation. The food was satisfactory, but good cuisine cannot compensate for poor service. It’s unlikely I’ll return or recommend this restaurant unless there are improvements in customer service training and noise management.

reviews.review_text:

Berkeley, California9 contributions

Great food, horrendous service
Jan 2024 • Couples
We wanted to have a nice dinner for our last evening in Tunis and chose La Salle a Manger. When we walked in, the hostess was not very welcoming and placed us in the area outside the main dining hall. She was then kind enough to find us a table and seated us in a much nicer area. Menus are all in French, but we managed to get by and understand it. The reason for the low rating is the horrible service. All the tables around us were served water, bread, and some snacks/sauces to go with it. We didn't receive any of this. The waiter may have asked us about it, but we don't speak French. Regardless, he should have found a way to work with us, such as bringing us the water and gesturing if we wanted it. He was incredibly pretentious and had a horrible attitude the whole night. The food was actually quite great, especially the duck. The only saving grace was Malik the mixologist. Really friendly guy, incredibly helpful, and makes awesome drinks.
